meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目里没人调用的代码安全删掉,并留下可回退的提交记录。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果项目里堆积了越来越多没人再调用的旧代码,想干净利落地清掉。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if old unused code keeps piling up in your project and you want it gone safely.

howto.what: 装好后 Claude 会扫描整个项目，找出没人引用的代码（没用到的导入、常量、函数、参数、孤立文件），用 LSP 引用查询逐一确认，再交给多个并行子代理按批次删除，每批单独提交。
howto.when: 当你提到 “remove dead code”、“dead code”、“cleanup” 等关键词，或要求清理无用代码时触发；也可用文件、目录或符号名缩小扫描范围。

say.text: 帮我清理这个项目里没被用到的代码
say.note: 会先扫描，再用 LSP 确认

say.text: 只扫描 src/utils 目录下的死代码
只处理 unusedFunc 这个符号的死代码

howto.what_en: Claude scans the project for unreferenced code (unused imports, constants, functions, parameters, orphaned files), confirms each with LSP reference lookups, then hands removals to parallel subagents in batches, each committed separately.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "remove dead code", "dead code", "cleanup" or similar, or ask to clean up unused code. A file, directory, or symbol name can narrow the scan.

say_en.text: Clean up the unused code in this project
say_en.note: Scans first, then confirms via LSP

say_en.text: Only scan the src/utils directory for dead code
say_en.note: Narrows the scan to one directory

say_en.text: Remove dead code, just the symbol unusedFunc
say_en.note: Narrows the scope to one symbol
